fieldValues.title: A holon cannot be driven to finish: every PR in it waits for the owner's merge
fieldValues.summary: Holon #49 was set up so that, after one sitting, development is driven without the owner. Every srs-web PR in it carries gate:owner-merge (the domain is not mature, so PRs are owner merged), so the WG quorum approved srs-web#646 and #647 and both then waited for the owner to run clerk merge. Three more PRs (#650, #642, #643) will wait the same way.
evidence: srs-web#646, #647: wg-quorum verdict=approve, label gate:owner-merge, merged by the owner 2026-10-29
owner comment on proposed decision: Until a domain meets all criteria, PRs are owner merged
fieldValues.body:
- The sitting can affirm the remedy and ratify the rulings, but not pre-authorise the merges, so the holon still needs the owner once per PR.
- Suggested change: the setup sitting may authorise merge-on-quorum for the holon's own PRs (as semanticops.com#43's owner answers did for #305), recorded on the parent, so the driver merges after quorum within that mandate.
